notes.title: Achievement bug fix
notes.notes:
Hello all! 

First, we want to sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the achievement bugs. We know how frustrating it can be when your hard-earned progress isn’t properly recognized, and we deeply appreciate your patience and understanding as we worked on these fixes.

🛠️ What’s New:

Simplified Achievements: We've removed some progressive achievements and replaced them with smaller, standalone ones to make tracking and completing them more enjoyable.
Major Fix: The progressive achievement for unlocking all endings is now fully functional. You can now show off your dedication and determination! 🎉

We’re truly sorry for the disruption this issue caused and are grateful for your continued support. As always, if you spot anything else that needs attention, please don’t hesitate to let us know.

Thank you, and happy gaming!

notes.title: Major Update for Baisu is Here!
notes.notes:
Major Update for Baisu!

Hello, Baisu players! We’re thrilled to bring you a major update packed with exciting new features, improvements, and bug fixes. Thank you for all the support, feedback, and enthusiasm you've shown since launch. We’re committed to making Baisu the best experience possible, and with this update, we’re taking it to the next level!

What’s New in This Update:
 🎮 Full Controller Support

We’ve added full controller support for a smoother and more immersive experience! Now you can dive into Baisu with your favorite game controller.

🏆 Steam Achievements

Achievements are here! Unlock a variety of achievements as you uncover the mysteries of Baisu. Each achievement is designed to enhance your exploration, reward your discoveries, and track key milestones in the story.

🌍 Localization & Subtitles

We’re excited to make Baisu more accessible to players worldwide with full localization of the interface and subtitles. Now available in:
•	English
•	Lithuanian
•	Spanish
•	French
•	Italian
•	Chinese (Simplified)
•	Portuguese (Brazilian)
•	German

Dive into the story of Baisu and the haunting mystery of Detective Clay Kriest’s investigation in your preferred language!

🔦 New Events & Immersive Elements

We’ve added a few new events to enrich the horror experience. Without giving too much away, expect more surprises as you explore. These additions build on the suspense and deepen the story’s chilling atmosphere.

⚙️ Optimization & Minor Fixes

We’ve optimized Baisu for better performance across various hardware setups, ensuring smoother gameplay for everyone. Additionally, we made minor adjustments and fixes to enhance the overall quality of your experience.

Big thanks once again to our amazing community for the feedback, patience, and encouragement. This update is a direct result of your engagement and input. We hope you enjoy all the new additions and improvements!
If you encounter any issues or have any suggestions, please reach out to us on Discord or other your preferred platform. We’re here and ready to help!

Happy (and haunting) gaming,
Tripleducks Studio

notes.title: New EN Voice Over + bug fixes and more
notes.notes:
Hello Gamers!

We’re thrilled to bring you our latest update, packed with exciting new features, crucial fixes, and essential improvements. Our team has been working tirelessly to enhance your gaming experience, and we’re grateful for your continued support and feedback. Here’s what’s new in this update:

New Features and Improvements:

 English Voice Over: We’ve added real English voice over to the game for a more immersive experience.
Tutorial Door Bug Fix: The bug with the tutorial door has been fixed.
Skip Tutorial Option: You can now skip the tutorial if you prefer to jump straight into the action.
Sound Adjustment Options: Added master sound adjustment and voice over sound adjustment options in the settings.
Performance Optimization: Optimized the most demanding parts of the game for smoother gameplay.
Event Fixes: Fixed several events and implemented overall minor fixes to improve the game.

Coming Real Soon:

Full Controller Support: Nearly completed, we’re ironing out the final details to provide full controller support.
Localization: Fully integrated localization, now we are pending final voice overs and translations.
Handheld Device Optimization: We’re close to fully optimizing the game for handheld devices.
New Events and Easter Eggs: A few new events and hidden surprises are being added for you to discover.

Our team is committed to continually improving the game and providing the best possible experience for you. We appreciate your patience and enthusiasm as we work towards these exciting updates. Stay tuned for more, and thank you for being part of our community!

notes.title: Minor bug update + some extra for you!
notes.notes:
Hello Gamers!

We’re excited to bring you a new update packed with fixes, improvements, and some thrilling additions to enhance your gaming experience. ːsteamhappyː


 Fixed Cameroid Issue: Resolved the problem with the Cameroid at the beginning of the game. Now, you can use the Cameroid and flashlight immediately after picking them up.


 Dog Behavior: Fixed the issue with the dog getting stuck.


 Audio Adjustments: Balanced sound effects that were too loud or too quiet.


 Balcony Bugs: Addressed minor bugs related to the balcony.


 Sensitive Scene Update: Improved a very sensitive scene in the game.


 Performance Optimization: Enhanced areas with significant performance drops.


 Additional Enhancements: Minor bug fixes and updates throughout the game.


 Heart Rate Enhancers: Added special elements to further increase your heart rate in the game ːsteamhappyː


We will continue to search for bugs and issues, and we'll keep adding new elements to enhance your gaming experience. Our top priority now is to implement full controller support, as we’ve noticed many players prefer using controllers. Additionally, we are focusing on optimizing the game without compromising its quality, which might take some time. Rest assured, our team of three is working diligently to provide the best possible experience for all of you.

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Thank You for Playing! Major Bug Fixes and Updates
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you to everyone who played our game! We deeply appreciate your support and patience, especially during the first day of our release, which didn’t go as smoothly as we had hoped due to some major issues with game saves.

Thanks to your all of your feedback, we have worked tirelessly for the past 16 hours to identify and fix all major bugs (as well as some minor ones) that have come to our attention. Here is a list of the fixes we’ve implemented:

Fixed Game Saves: You can now exit to the main menu and hit continue if something goes wrong.
Fixed Character Location After Loading a Game.
Fixed Flashlight Issues: Both non-working flashlights and instances of having two flashlights.
Fixed Weird Texture Glitches.
Fixed Dog Mechanics.
Fixed Locked Doors Near the End of the Game.
Fixed Key and Item Descriptions.
Adjusted Sound Levels: Resolved issues with sounds being too loud or too quiet.
Fixed Endings.
Other Small Fixes: Addressed various minor issues discovered through your streams, videos, and our extensive testing.
Thank you once again to all our players, and a special thanks to those who reported these bugs. Your feedback is crucial in helping us create a better experience for everyone!

WARNING! Old saves will not work, you should start new game and it should be all good from there :)

If you encounter any other issues or have any questions or requests, please don’t hesitate to contact us on Discord or your preferred platform. We’re here to help and will respond as quickly as possible.

Happy gaming!
